# 4 bedroom terraced house for sale

> Homesearch Direct is pleased to offer to the market, this spacious four bedroom end terraced property, situated on a popular street in the highly sought after urban village of Denton Holme. The property which has been in the family for over 50 years would suit a variety of purchasers and offers fantastic potential for buyers looking to put their own stamp on.
